C0338.title: Shanghai's First Case: Criminal Sentencing for Bulk Real-Name Game Account Registration
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0338.summary: Shanghai police cracked the city first case involving programmatic bulk real-name registration of game accounts. The criminal gang illegally obtained citizens personal information, wrote scripts to bypass game company registration restrictions, and registered and verified game accounts in bulk before selling the accounts and passwords for profit. The case exposed the combined risks of SMS receiving, scripted registration, and real-name information abuse in the game account black market. The court imposed prison sentences on the defendants in the first-instance judgment and ordered them to make a public apology.
